title: OpenRC aircraft data v2
description: Strict structural and per-field validation for openrc-aircraft v2. Coupled physical validation remains in AircraftData and AircraftContract.
$comment: Generated by research/aircraft-standardization/build_schema.py from the reviewed v1 numeric constraints and app/data/schema/aircraft-contract-v2.json. Runtime additionally checks branch/capability relations, positive inertia references, unique contact names and steering topology. Reference-only quantities have no force effect. PhysicalIdentity additionally enforces hull-point count alignment and global ID uniqueness across inventory, supports, hull probes, propulsion and surfaces; the offline companion is research/aircraft-standardization/physical_identity.py.

ground_effect.description: M5-GE-1 optional wing/tail ground-effect law constants (app/physics/ground_effect.gd): sigma = c*(h/b)^e/(1+c*(h/b)^e) for the strips' induced angle/drag and for the tail downwash. Runtime also requires the coupled strip map and the free tail law.

wingPolarSamples.$comment: Flat four-column rows: angle magnitude, lift magnitude, profile drag, attached fraction. Runtime enforces groups of four, column ranges, ordering, C1 boundaries and induced reference consistency.
